verdict.rationale: Scheduling recurring jobs, such as recurring payments or scheduled transfers, is a fair question for a payments and wallet API platform, so the axis applies. However, the evidence documents no scheduler, cron, or recurring-workflow capability. Delegation time windows, order-intent expirations and webhooks are adjacent controls that bound or report on one-off actions. They are not a recurring schedule, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
